title: This Wednesday, 14 January 26 … you're invited
excerpt: Friend and gifted documentary filmmaker Kristen Cesario Irving (see her latest: TRUE BELIEVER, here: https://kinema.com/events/True-Believer-nfff3z) has invited me for a live online conversation about the ongoing authoritarian takeover happening here in the US, especially in…
body:
Friend and gifted documentary filmmaker Kristen Cesario Irving (see her latest: TRUE BELIEVER, here: [https://kinema.com/events/True-Believer-nfff3z](https://kinema.com/events/True-Believer-nfff3z)) has invited me for a live online conversation about the ongoing authoritarian takeover happening here in the US, especially in light of recent ICE violence: 14 January 2026 at 1 pm PT/4pm ET.

It will take place on Kristen's Substack, and will be based on an interview that Kristen filmed with me ten years ago.

Here's the link for the livestream:

[https://open.substack.com/live-stream/97188](https://open.substack.com/live-stream/97188)

And here's background information for the livestream:

[https://kristenirvingcesario.substack.com/p/the-cost-of-loving-thy-neighbor](https://kristenirvingcesario.substack.com/p/the-cost-of-loving-thy-neighbor)

Here's backstory and video of the 2016 interview (you'll see I look way younger):

[https://kristenirvingcesario.substack.com/p/part-3-this-ones-for-the-pastors](https://kristenirvingcesario.substack.com/p/part-3-this-ones-for-the-pastors)

A few excerpts … from 2016:

“If you are a pastor who is aware that your congregation is more devoted to Fox News than to Jesus Christ, know that remaining silent endangers your integrity and soul.”

“We face a situation comparable to 1930s Germany. Authenticity must come first before meaningful action.”

I hope you'll consider joining us, either live or asynchronously.
